newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran pardons over 700 prisoners on eve of Eid.
newsitem.headline: Iran pardons over 700 prisoners on eve of Eid.

text.p: Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei pardoned more than 700 prisoners on Saturday, the eve of celebrations marking the start of the Eid al-Fitr feast, Iranian radio said.
At the request of Iran's senior judge Ayatollah Mohammad Yazdi, amnesty was granted to 782 convicts sentenced by the country's general, revolutionary and military courts.

Khamenei also agreed "to pardon all those serving sentences for non-payment of fines for offences which do not affect third parties," said the radio, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
Iran will celebrate the start of the Eid on Sunday, marking the end of the fasting month of Ramadan.
